lines.en: scene yukineedsmoney1
If there was anything in life Yuki hated more than the Yamaguchi estate, it was the man who ran it.
lines.zh: 如果说这世上还有什么比山口家的宅邸更让 Yuki 恨的，那就是掌管这座宅邸的那个男人。

lines.en: That wasn’t always the case, though.
lines.zh: 不过，以前并不是这样。

lines.en: To be clear, she never had any respect for him. But back when taking his name sounded like a good idea, her feelings hadn’t blossomed into {i}hate{/i} yet.
lines.zh: 说清楚点，她从来没尊重过他。但在当年、冠上他的姓氏听起来还是个不错的主意时，她的感情还没有开成{i}仇恨{/i}的花。

lines.en: That would come over the next several years between the bouts of willing sedation that he’d thrust upon her in exchange for sex.
lines.zh: 那份仇恨是在接下来的几年里长出来的，夹在一次又一次他为了换取性而强加给她的自愿麻醉之间。

lines.en: “A fair trade,” she thought. And it’s not as if she would remember most of it anyway as the showering of {i}presents{/i} would be a blanket she could hold over her face to ignore what was happening.
lines.zh: 「公平的交易，」她想。反正大部分她也不会记得——那些源源不断的{i}礼物{/i}会像一条毯子，她可以拉过头顶，把正在发生的事挡在外面。

lines.en: “Just a few more minutes. One more mouthful. Then the world will be mine again. And I can forget why I’m here in the first place.”
lines.zh: 「再忍几分钟。再含一口。然后世界就又是我的了。而我就能忘掉自己到底为什么在这里。」

lines.en: It became less bearable as time went on. And the salty aftertaste of poor decisions went from tolerable to cancerous each time she’d wake up in a pool of her own spit.
lines.zh: 随着时间推移，这越来越难以忍受。而每次她在一滩自己的口水中醒来，糟糕决定留下的咸腥余味，就从可以忍受变成了癌。

lines.en: She was still doing that nowadays, but at least the salt was gone.
lines.zh: 如今她还是会那样，但至少那股咸味没了。

lines.en: The shame never left, though. And it was more prevalent now than it had been in a very long time as she promised herself she’d only come here if and {i}when{/i} she ran out of options.
lines.zh: 可羞耻从未离开。而且它现在比很久以来的任何时候都更浓——因为她曾向自己保证，只有在走投无路{i}时{/i}才会来这里。

lines.en: Because she always knew it was only a matter of time. And she knew that, one way or another, her past would catch up to her and force her back underwater.
lines.zh: 因为她一直知道这只是时间问题。她也知道，不管怎样，她的过去迟早会追上她，把她重新按回水底。

lines.en: And while the specifics this time were somewhat different than they’d been in the past, the end result remained the same.
lines.zh: 而尽管这一次的具体情况与过去有些不同，结局却是一样的。

lines.en: She needed money. And she had {i}access{/i} to money.
lines.zh: 她需要钱。而她有弄到钱的{i}门路{/i}。

lines.en: But it would come at a cost.
lines.zh: 但那是有代价的。

lines.en: : None? Sounds good to me. Throw her outside. She smells like shit now and we literally {i}just{/i} got the tatami cleaned.
lines.zh: : 没有？正合我意。把她扔出去。她现在臭得像坨屎，而我们{i}刚{/i}把榻榻米清理干净。

lines.en: : But Boss-
lines.zh: : 可是老大——

lines.en: scene black
: I told you to fucking throw her out! When I say “bark,” you bark. When I say, “jump-“
lines.zh: : 我他妈的让你把她扔出去！我说「叫」，你就叫。我说「跳——」

lines.en: : Yeah, yeah. We all jump. Come on, I’ll help you carry her. I just want to find, like...gloves first.
lines.zh: : 好好好。我们都跳。来吧，我帮你抬她。我只是想先找……那个……手套。

lines.en: scene yukineedsmoney29
Somewhere in the midst of everything, it started to rain.
lines.zh: 在这一切的某个时刻，天下起了雨。

lines.en: How long had it been since then?
lines.zh: 从那时起，过了多久？

lines.en: Yuki Yamaguchi was tossed outside of the estate grounds, left there like a bag of trash to be collected the next time the truck came around.
lines.zh: Yuki Yamaguchi 被扔到宅邸门外，像一袋垃圾一样留在那里，等着垃圾车下次来的时候被收走。

lines.en: It was cold, but it was a welcome cold. Worsened only by the fact that the water pouring down from the sky did little to wash away the sins of man.
lines.zh: 很冷，但那是她甘愿承受的冷。唯一更糟的是，从天上倾泻而下的水，洗不掉人的罪。

lines.en: It was like this when she’d shower too, though.
lines.zh: 不过她洗澡的时候也是这样。

lines.en: Because from Yuki’s point of view, she was permanently unclean. And it’s not as if any of this mattered now that her life was coming to an end.
lines.zh: 因为在 Yuki 看来，她永远都是不干净的。而现在她的生命正在走向尽头，这些也都无所谓了。

lines.en: She wasn’t even {i}thinking{/i} about the money anymore.
lines.zh: 她甚至已经不去{i}想{/i}钱了。

lines.en: She was just glad to be alive — if even for a minute longer.
lines.zh: 她只是庆幸自己还活着——哪怕只是多活一分钟。

lines.en: But then there was a sound.
lines.zh: 但就在这时，传来了一个声音。

lines.en: Footsteps, coming closer.
lines.zh: 脚步声，越来越近。

lines.en: Footsteps that {i}weren’t{/i} dying out.
lines.zh: {i}没有{/i}渐渐消失的脚步声。

lines.en: scene yukineedsmoney30
A last burst of energy grants her the strength to lift her head and witness the truck pull up to carry her away.
lines.zh: 最后一阵力气让她抬起头，看见那辆卡车停下来，准备把她带走。

lines.en: scene yukineedsmoney31
: {i}Aaah...{/i}
But when she lifts her head, what she sees is not a truck. Nor the headlights that signal the end of her days.
lines.zh: 可当她抬起头，她看见的不是卡车。也不是宣告她末日的大灯。

lines.en: : Well, well, well...
lines.zh: : 哎呀，哎呀，哎呀……

lines.en: scene black
scene yukineedsmoney32
And yet...
lines.zh: 然而……

lines.en: She will {i}still{/i} be collected.
lines.zh: 她{i}还是{/i}会被收走。

lines.en: : If it isn’t the Dragon herself.
lines.zh: : 这不是那条龙本人吗。

lines.en: : Tough day, I take it?
lines.zh: : 看来今天不好过？

lines.en: : Nee...sama?...
: Long time, no see...
lines.zh: : 好久不见……

lines.en: scene black
: Yuki.
lines.zh: : Yuki。

lines.en: $ yukispring5 = True
scene bedroom_night
I haven’t seen Niki or Ami since we made it back from the beach...
lines.zh: 从海边回来之后，我就没再见过 Niki 和 Ami……

lines.en: But everyone else will still accept me...
lines.zh: 但其他人还是会接纳我的……

lines.en: Won’t they?
lines.zh: 对吧？

lines.en: I should...figure out what to do next.
lines.zh: 我该……想想接下来该怎么办。
